_help: Full URLs. These become the Safari start-page tiles and the social row in Contact.
_note: Keep the keys as-is — Safari picks each tile's brand colour by matching the words 'github' / 'linkedin' / 'twitter'. Leave one blank to drop it entirely.
_note2: 'medium' and 'notion' are the link-only apps: they get an icon in Applications and on the desktop, and open in a real browser tab.
